sourceExample: Pinned LPC Revised Gable Shingle Roof A shallow brown front-gable roofline, used once intact and unscaled over a centered five-tile cream wall plate with a source-derived 1/3/5 triangular siding infill and one-tile side eaves.
buildingOrigin: top_left_of_9x9_recipe_envelope; visible roof begins at local [1,2], wall plate spans local x=2..6
assemblyRule: The exterior footprint is an architectural envelope, not the facade width. One exact 7x4 front-gable roofline overhangs a centered five-tile wall plate. A visual-only 1/3/5 stepped cream-siding infill occupies only the gable opening beneath the slopes; the roofline draws afterward to mask its stepped outer edge. No rectangular gable-backing plane is permitted.

requirements: one intact 7x4 shallow brown front-gable roofline owns the visible rake/eave silhouette
a 1/3/5 cream siding infill fills only the triangular gable opening beneath the roofline
roof visual envelope is wider than the five-tile wall plate, producing one-tile side eaves
no synthetic rectangular gable-backing wall row exists behind transparent roof pixels
front wall body begins immediately beneath the gable infill and remains behind the roof draw order
front door remains on world tile [59,36] after the 9x9 architectural-envelope migration
editor and client resolve the same BuildingRecipe/BuildingInstance/PublishedWorldAsset session

gableInfill.note: One-tile exact cream siding cells form a 1/3/5 stepped gable behind the source-authored roofline. The roofline draws afterward and masks the stepped outer edge; the five-tile facade begins immediately below at visual local y=6.
